The marble, with warm light, promotes a beautiful, dignified ambiance, as does the vividly embroidered flag.

100.name: Guild Safes
100.desc: A place to store guild assets.\nFrom trivial odds and ends to valuable treasures, each object stored here is a valuable asset gathered for guild unity and cooperation. The diligent Harrison manages it meticulously, without missing anything.

101.name: Conference Room
101.desc: Important guild issues deserve to be discussed with class and professionalism. Here in the Conference Room, your guild members can come together to make plans, resolve their differences, and face the world with a united front.

102.name: Training Area
102.desc: A training space for knights who have sworn allegiance to the guild. Work out by the light of that sword-shaped window, and enjoy your gains.

103.name: Enhancement Altar
103.desc: The power of the Divine Anvil awaits anyone who challenges their limits. Grow your strength, and earn your guildmates' recognition.

104.name: Supply Station
104.desc: A place for various Guild Castle supplies. These items support the guild members' overall activities, from recreation to romance.

105.name: Library
105.desc: A treasure trove of knowledge, featuring all kinds of books. Any good guild member owes it to themselves to spend time reading and immersing themselves in daily self-development. Here, the joy of learning is open to everyone. As long as you don't suffer from headaches.

200.name: Living Room
200.desc: This space welcomes visitors to the Guild Castle. Here, invited guests can stay comfortably, and residents can use it as a warm, cozy break room.

201.name: Storage Room
201.desc: A nest for all sorts of odds and ends.\nThe gears on the wall are all that remains of the castle's old outer-wall clockwork. Looking at it, you feel more in touch with the castle's former residents.

202.name: Dining Room
202.desc: A place for feasting and friendship. Enjoy the melodies, or even play one yourself on the piano. The plants seem to perk up whenever someone performs.

203.name: Swimming Pool
203.desc: A small watery getaway for the Guild Castle. Swimming with everyone provides a pleasant escape from your day-to-day work.\n\nNot a swimmer? No worries, you can always lie back and relax by the poolside. Those colorful tubes are calling you!

204.name: Party Room
204.desc: What party will be held today? Open one of the gift boxes piled on the floor. Inside is the care and friendship of someone who wrapped it while thinking of you.

205.name: Greenhouse
205.desc: A place where the warmest sunlight shines down on the Guild Castle. A cup of leisurely tea, surrounded by green leaves, is the best way to erase the fatigue of a difficult adventure. Colorful seasonal flowers are waiting for your care.

6.desc: Reduces the time required to change rooms. The more research you do, the more often you can change rooms.\r\n#cSlots that are already on cooldown will not be reduced additionally.#

7.desc: You can obtain the Guild Safe, which is one of the special rooms. Obtained rooms can be checked in the Guild Castle Rooms UI.
